standard.summary: gpu=训练安全点真实出 PNG（推荐）；cpu=只写 .cpu_preview.json 任务清单，当前不会生成图片；off=关闭
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.cpu: 预览走 CPU，慢，不抢显存。
optionDescriptions.hybrid: 默认档:按角色分开摆放(VAE 与文本塔留在 CPU,只让 DiT 常驻),避开预览解码那一下的显存尖峰;只有 anima 与 newbie 实现了这档,其他家族会落到自己做得到的档位。

standard_en.summary: gpu = produces real PNGs at a training-safe point (recommended); cpu = only writes a .cpu_preview.json task list and generates no images today; off = disabled
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.gpu: Previews on the GPU: fast, and uses VRAM.
optionDescriptions.cpu: Previews on the CPU: slow, and does not compete for VRAM.
optionDescriptions.hybrid: The default gear: it places things by role (the VAE and the text tower stay on the CPU and only the DiT is resident), avoiding the VRAM spike of the preview decode; only anima and newbie implement this gear, and the other families fall back to the best gear they can manage.

advanced.principle: gpu=训练安全点真实出 PNG（推荐）；cpu=只写 .cpu_preview.json 任务清单，当前不会生成图片；off=关闭

advanced_en.principle: gpu = real PNG generation at training safe points (recommended); cpu = only writes a .cpu_preview.json task list, currently generates no images; off = disabled.
